items.title: Microsoft Patches 173 Vulnerabilities, Including Exploited Windows Flaws

items.description: A threat actor called TigerJack is constantly targeting developers with malicious extensions published on Microsoft's Visual Code (VSCode) marketplace and OpenVSX registry to steal cryptocurrency and plant backdoors. [...]

items.description: A new side-channel attack called Pixnapping enables a malicious Android app with no permissions to extract sensitive data by stealing pixels displayed by applications or websites, and reconstructing them to derive the content. [...]
